title: Collapse chart_data_service.dart's *Live methods — byte-identical duplicates of their non-Live counterparts
why: getDailyCompletionsLive's own docstring admits it: 'The method name retains the historic Live suffix for callsite stability; the filter is [trackAchievement]' — the same default tier getDailyCompletions already uses. Diffing the two bodies shows they run the exact same query, same bucketing, same effective-start logic; getCumulativeProgress/getCumulativeProgressLive are the same story. Roughly 140 lines exist twice with no behavioral difference today. A future change to one (a new tier parameter, a bucketing tweak, a bugfix) has no compiler-enforced reason to also land in its twin, so the two will silently diverge the next time either is touched under time pressure — the same failure mode already realized in finding #1.
recommendation: Make getDailyCompletionsLive / getCumulativeProgressLive one-line delegates to the base methods, or delete them and repoint recent_activity_providers.dart at getDailyCompletions/getCumulativeProgress directly.
acceptance_criteria: chart_data_service.dart's *Live methods contain no independent query/bucketing logic — they either don't exist or delegate to the base method in one line.

corrections: getDailyCompletionsLive is dead code (no callers found), not merely a 'live duplicate' needing repointing as the recommendation implies — it can simply be deleted. This makes removal easier than described, not harder; doesn't undermine the finding.
